newsitem.title: NICARAGUA: Five Nicaraguan leftist rebels killed in combat.
newsitem.headline: Five Nicaraguan leftist rebels killed in combat.

text.p: Five leftist rebels were killed in a clash between Nicaraguan troops and a unit of the Andres Castro United Front (FUAC) over the weekend, the army said on Tuesday.

Three people were also injured in the fighting on Sunday outside the town of Siuna, 200 miles (320 km) northeast of Managua in the remote North Atlantic Autonomous Region, the army said in a statement.
FUAC is thought by the army to comprise about 70 former members of the Sandinista army.
The army said the attack came after the FUAC left a specially designated "peace zone" where it had agreed to remain while it negotiated a disarmament agreement with the government.

The government of right-wing President Arnoldo Aleman, who took power on Jan. 10, is trying to negotiate the disarmament of various right and left-wing armed bands remaining from the Nicaraguan civil war which ended in 1990.
